svg.title: Blade Reader
svg.desc: A neon sign reading Blade Reader over a rain-soaked city at night, or an orange haze by day. Beside it, six blade fuses in a fuse panel, each output screw clamping a finger of a comb-shaped circuit board that shows the current on that way, and a vertical katakana sign.
svg.text: CURRENT ON EVERY WAY OF A BLADE FUSE PANEL
I'VE SEEN THINGS YOU PEOPLE WOULDN'T BELIEVE.
FRIDGES DRAWING AMPS OFF THE SHOULDER OF ORION.
